verdict.description: approve only when there are zero findings with severity blocker or major.

summary.description: Two sentences maximum. What changed since the previous round, and what still stands.

findings.description: All findings that still stand this round, plus any newly withdrawn ones.

id.description: Stable kebab-case slug identifying this finding, e.g. 'unbounded-retry-loop'. REUSE the exact id from a previous round when re-reporting the same issue. Never renumber or rename an id across rounds.

status.description: new = first raised this round. upheld = raised before, author's response did not resolve it. withdrawn = raised before, now retracted (either fixed or the author's counter-argument was correct).

severity.description: blocker = incorrect, unsafe, or will not work. major = significant design or correctness risk. minor = worth fixing, not worth blocking. nit = taste.

file.description: Repo-relative path, or empty string if the finding is not anchored to a file.

line.description: 1-indexed line number, or 0 if not anchored to a line.

detail.description: Why this is wrong and what breaks as a result. Concrete inputs or conditions, not generalities.

suggested_fix.description: The specific change that would resolve it. Empty string if you genuinely have no suggestion.
